Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. As discussed, we wanted to kick off the renewal + uplift planning so we have a clear runway for the QBR and procurement milestones. High-level goals:

- Lock new term and commit by end of May
- Add the 30% throughput uplift for batch inference to support new features
- Align on security evidence and billing/pricing path

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Mutual Action Plan (attached) — review and mark any redlines
2) Confirm QBR date (looking at two windows below)
   - Option A: Tue, May 7 (10:00–11:00 PT)
   - Option B: Wed, May 15 (14:00–15:00 PT)
3) Procurement / Legal kickoff (once MAP is agreed)

Would you please: 1) confirm which QBR window works; 2) confirm contacts for procurement/legal who should be looped (we'll add David K. from our side for contract coordination)?

I've attached the BloomPay_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx and a SOC2 evidence request template to help the security ask. Monica will own the technical runbook + capacity estimates; Irene will own governance/SLA items. I'll coordinate the calendar and HubSpot deal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
